cues.en: Mike Cohen: I'm now going to tell you about two different ways of scaling the axis in graphs, linear scaling versus logarithmic scaling.
cues.zh: 現在介紹圖表座標軸的兩種縮放方式：線性尺度與對數尺度。

cues.en: So let me start by defining what linear scale versus logarithmic axis scale means, and then I will tell you about some of the advantages
cues.zh: 先定義兩者的意思，再談這兩種圖表縮放方式的，

cues.en: and disadvantages of these two ways of scaling plots.
cues.zh: 優缺點。

cues.en: So here we have a plot with linear y-axis scaling.
cues.zh: 這張圖的y軸是線性尺度。

cues.en: Now there's not gonna be any data 'cause for this slide the data don't actually matter.
cues.zh: 這張投影片沒有資料，因為資料本身不重要。

cues.en: What does matter, what I want you to pay attention to is the fact that the spacing on the y-axis ticks are done by addition.
cues.zh: 要注意的是，y軸刻度間距，是透過加法決定。

cues.en: So we start at zero and then we say zero plus 10 is 10 plus 10 plus 10 plus 10.
So we are creating, or the spacing between each of these ticks on the y-axis is given by the addition operation.
cues.zh: 也就是y軸各刻度之間的間距，透過加法運算得到。

cues.en: Now let's think about logarithmic y-axis scaling.
cues.zh: 想想對數尺度y軸。

cues.en: So now we have a similar plot except the ticks are no longer defined by addition.
cues.zh: 這是類似的圖，但刻度不再由加法定義。

cues.en: We don't get them by summing the same number.
cues.zh: 不是反覆加上相同數字。

cues.en: Instead we get them by multiplying by the same number.
cues.zh: 而是乘上相同數字。

cues.en: Now in this case I'm multiplying by 10.
cues.zh: 這個例子乘10。

cues.en: So we start off at one times 10 is 10, times 10 times 10 times 10, we end up with 10,000.
So this plot is growing really, really fast.
cues.zh: 所以這張圖增加得非常快。

cues.en: That also means that in linear terms, the spacing between each successive tick mark is not the same.
cues.zh: 也代表，用線性觀點看，相鄰刻度之間的差距不同。

cues.en: These two are nine units apart.
cues.zh: 這兩個相差九個單位。

cues.en: These two are 90 units apart, 900 units apart and so on.
cues.zh: 這兩個相差90個單位，再來900個，依此類推。

cues.en: So this is logarithmic y-axis scaling.
cues.zh: 這是對數尺度y軸。

cues.en: The spacing between the ticks is given by multiplication, not by addition with linear scaling.
cues.zh: 刻度間隔由乘法決定，不是線性尺度的加法。

cues.en: Now here I'm showing the multiplication by a factor of 10.
cues.zh: 這裡展示乘上10。

cues.en: That is the most common way of showing logarithmic scales.
cues.zh: 這是最常見的對數尺度呈現方式。

cues.en: So by incrementing by a factor of 10, multiplying by 10, but you're not limited to multiplying by 10.
cues.zh: 每次增加十倍、乘10，但不只限於乘10。

cues.en: Sometimes multiplication by other numbers might make more sense.
cues.zh: 有時乘其他數更合理。

cues.en: Sometimes you see two.
cues.zh: 有時看到2。

cues.en: So this could be two, four, eight, 16, 32.
Sometimes a base of eight makes sense.
cues.zh: 有時以8為底比較合理。

cues.en: It would be eight and 64 and so on.
cues.zh: 就是8、64，依此類推。

cues.en: But most of the time it's going to be powers of 10.
cues.zh: 但多數時候是10的各次方。

cues.en: And because these are growing powers of 10, and also just for visual aesthetic reasons, these numbers start to get really long.
cues.zh: 因為這些是10的次方不斷增長，也為了視覺美觀，數字會變得很長。

cues.en: They start to take up a lot of real estate horizontally on the graph here.
cues.zh: 開始占用很多圖表水平空間。

cues.en: So it's also common in log scaling, so here I'm just using a different term, logarithmic y-axis scaling, log scaling.
cues.zh: 所以在log scaling，也就是對數尺度y軸，我只是換個詞說，

cues.en: It's common to use scientific notation here.
cues.zh: 常使用科學記號。

cues.en: So this would be 10 to the zero, 10 to the one, two, three, four, and so on.
cues.zh: 就是10的0次方、1次方、2、3、4，依此類推。

cues.en: Again, the principle is the same.
cues.zh: 原理相同。

cues.en: We are spacing by multiplication instead of spacing by addition.
cues.zh: 間隔依乘法，而非加法。

cues.en: Now here I'm only describing logarithmic versus linear scaling. For the y-axis, this is called a log scaled plot.
cues.zh: 這裡只描述y軸對數或線性尺度，這叫做對數尺度圖。

cues.en: You can also scale the x-axis logarithmically or linearly.
cues.zh: x軸也能設對數或線性尺度。

cues.en: So if the x-axis is linearly scaled and the y-axis is logarithmically scaled, we just call that a log scaled plot or logarithmic y-axis scaled plot.
cues.zh: 如果x軸線性、y軸對數，稱為對數尺度圖，或y軸對數尺度圖。

cues.en: If you have logarithmic spacing, so multiplication based spacing on both axes.
cues.zh: 如果兩個軸都是對數間距，也就是以乘法決定間隔，

cues.en: So log on the X and log on the Y.
cues.zh: x軸對數、y軸對數，

cues.en: Then we would call this a log log plot.
cues.zh: 就叫雙對數圖，log-log plot。

cues.en: So you repeat the word log twice because it's log on X and log on Y.
cues.zh: log說兩次，因為x與y都是對數。

cues.en: Okay, so I'm sure you are super curious about how data look the same data in a linear scale versus a logarithmic scale.
cues.zh: 你一定很好奇，相同資料用線性與對數尺度，看起來如何。

cues.en: Well, lucky for you I have read your mind and I made a slide showing that.
cues.zh: 幸好我讀懂你的心，做了投影片展示。

cues.en: So here we have two functions, X equals X.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩個函數，x=x。

cues.en: So this is just a linear scale.
cues.zh: 這只是線性尺度。

cues.en: Might not look like it's increasing linearly, but that's because the X axis only goes up to 10 here, which unfortunately I'm not showing you for some reason.
cues.zh: 也許看起來不像線性增長，是因為x軸只到10，不知為何我沒顯示。

cues.en: But this goes up to X equals 10.
cues.zh: 但這裡到x=10。

cues.en: So in fact the linear scale goes up to here, Y equals 10, and here we have Y equals E to the X I see there's a typo here.
cues.zh: 所以線性函數其實只到y=10。這裡是y=e^x，我發現有個筆誤。

cues.en: This should say Y equals X and Y equals E to the X.
cues.zh: 這裡應該寫y=x與y=e^x。

cues.en: So this is the y-axis.
cues.zh: 這是y軸。

cues.en: Apologies for that little typo here.
cues.zh: 為這個小筆誤道歉。

cues.en: So here we have the function E to the X, and you've already seen this function before.
cues.zh: 這是e^x，之前已經看過。

cues.en: It grows exponentially.
cues.zh: 它呈指數增長。

cues.en: It grows really, really fast as we get to larger numbers.
cues.zh: 數字越大，就增長得非常非常快。

cues.en: In fact, it's even off the charts.
cues.zh: 甚至超出圖表範圍。

cues.en: It's past 100 by the time we get to like E to the four or five or wherever this is here.
cues.zh: 到e的4或5次方，或大概這個位置，就超過100。

cues.en: Okay, so this is a linear y-axis.
cues.zh: 這是線性y軸。

cues.en: Now what I'm gonna show you is exactly these same two functions, but plotted on a logarithmically scaled y-axis and it looks totally different.
cues.zh: 現在展示完全相同的兩個函數，但改成對數尺度y軸，看起來完全不同。

cues.en: Same data, looks really different.
cues.zh: 相同資料，看起來很不一樣。

cues.en: Here, this, what is actually a linear function.
cues.zh: 這裡其實是線性函數。

cues.en: This is actually just a line, Y equals X, but it looks like, well it looks like a logarithm, looks like the log of X here.
cues.zh: 其實只是直線y=x，但看起來像對數，像log(x)。

cues.en: But you have to be really mindful of this because this is not actually the log of X.
cues.zh: 必須很小心，因為這其實不是log(x)。

cues.en: This is Y equals X is a perfect linear function, but it's plotted on a logarithmic scale.
cues.zh: y=x是完全線性的函數，只是畫在對數尺度上。

cues.en: Conversely, E to the X is just a straight line.
cues.zh: 相反地，e^x成了一條直線。

cues.en: And this is a straight line because remember I explained before when I introduced natural logarithm and natural exponential,
cues.zh: 之所以是直線，記得介紹自然對數與自然指數時說過，

cues.en: that these two functions are inverses of each other.
cues.zh: 兩者互為反函數。

cues.en: So if we have logarithmic scaling for a, for an exponential then we just end up with a straight line.
cues.zh: 所以把指數函數畫在對數尺度上，就得到直線。

cues.en: Okay, so the same data can look quite different on a linear scale versus a logarithmic scale.
cues.zh: 相同資料，線性與對數尺度看起來會很不一樣。

cues.en: So what are the pros and cons of linear versus logarithmic scaling?
cues.zh: 它們有什麼優缺點？

cues.en: Well, that's listed here in this table.
cues.zh: 這張表列出來了。

cues.en: Linear scaling over here, logarithmic scaling over here.
cues.zh: 這邊是線性，這邊是對數。

cues.en: Linear scaling is generally easier to interpret, and that's really just because most of the plots that you see in your life are linearly scaled
cues.zh: 線性尺度通常較容易解讀，因為一生中看過的大多數圖，都是線性尺度，

cues.en: or have linear scaling Y axes.
cues.zh: 或y軸是線性。

cues.en: So they're just a little bit easier to interpret.
cues.zh: 所以比較容易理解。

cues.en: Logarithmic scaling might need a little bit more explanation or unpacking, particularly if you are showing the data, showing the logarithmically scaled axes
cues.zh: 對數尺度可能需要更多說明，尤其向一般觀眾展示，

cues.en: to a general audience.
cues.zh: 對數尺度座標軸時。

cues.en: By general audience, I mean people who are not necessarily used to looking at logarithmic scales, maybe people who don't have some formal training in some,
cues.zh: 一般觀眾，是指不一定習慣看對數尺度的人，也許沒有接受某些，

cues.en: some aspect of science, some area of science where logarithmic scales are common.
cues.zh: 常用對數尺度的科學領域正式訓練。

cues.en: So linear scaling is also easily scaled to big numbers or small numbers or negative numbers.
cues.zh: 線性尺度也很容易用於大數、小數，或負數。

cues.en: Logarithmic scaling, depending on how you set things up, they often don't even work with negative numbers or you might need to translate the data.
cues.zh: 對數尺度則取決於設定，經常不能用於負數，或需要平移資料。

cues.en: You might need to apply some kind of a transformation to the data in order to work with a negative y-axis.
cues.zh: 可能需要對資料套用某種轉換，才能處理負的y軸。

cues.en: So linear scaling can obscure trends or comparisons across variables.
cues.zh: 線性尺度可能掩蓋趨勢，或不同變數間的比較。

cues.en: That's really just the case if those variables grow very fast or if they grow to be very small.
cues.zh: 尤其變數增加得很快，或縮小到非常小時。

cues.en: Logarithmic scaling tends to be most appropriate for physics and biology, finance or growth, or not necessarily really big numbers per se,
cues.zh: 對數尺度通常最適合物理、生物、金融或成長，不一定只是很大的數，

cues.en: but when you have really big differences between numbers.
cues.zh: 而是數字之間的差異非常大。

cues.en: So when you have functions or data that really span multiple different orders of magnitude, they really span a lot of different scales,
cues.zh: 當函數或資料跨越很多數量級、很多不同尺度，

cues.en: then logarithmic scaling tends to be more appropriate than linear scaling.
cues.zh: 對數通常比線性更適合。

cues.en: My personal recommendation is that you should try to use linear scaling whenever possible.
cues.zh: 我個人建議，能用線性就盡量用。

cues.en: That's mainly for this reason.
cues.zh: 主要是因為這個理由。

cues.en: Linear scaling is what everyone is used to seeing, so they tend to be easier to interpret.
cues.zh: 每個人都習慣看線性尺度，所以通常更容易解讀。

cues.en: So I would say use linear scaling unless you have a good reason to use log plots.
cues.zh: 所以除非有好理由使用對數圖，否則用線性。

cues.en: And so therefore you should use logarithmically scaled plots only when it's really the appropriate thing.
cues.zh: 只在確實適當時，才使用對數尺度圖。

cues.en: And don't just use it because you think it's cool and it makes your graphs look harder to interpret and therefore you think it might make you look smarter.
cues.zh: 不要只是覺得酷，讓圖難以解讀，就以為會顯得比較聰明。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Linear versus logarithmic axis scaling.
cues.zh: 線性與對數座標軸尺度。

cues.en: The key difference is that with linear scaling, the tick marks are defined by addition, and with logarithmic scaling, the tick marks are defined by multiplication.
cues.zh: 關鍵差別，是線性刻度以加法定義，對數刻度以乘法定義。

cues.en: In general, it's better to use linear plots because they're easier to read and logarithmic plots should be used when it's most appropriate for that particular type of data.
cues.zh: 一般而言，線性圖較易讀，所以比較好；對數圖則在最適合特定資料類型時使用。
